semantics.identity_rule: Every Routine has an explicit stable canonical identity.
semantics.content_rule: Routine content references exact commands/operations rather than embedding ungoverned executable text.
semantics.order_rule: Step order is explicit semantic data.
semantics.definition_rule: Routine definition is static canonical data distinct from a running execution.
semantics.composition_rule: Routine may invoke another Routine only through explicit reference and recursion/cycle policy.
semantics.authority_rule: Possession/visibility of Routine definition does not grant execution authority.

invariants.rule: Routine definitions and runner executions are separate canonical identities; runners execute explicit ordered routine content through the normal governed dispatch boundary.
